sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports
sections.what: Brings in React, icons, the store, the card, button and theme toggle components. This section only sets up the file.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code beyond normal file setup.

sections.name: SettingsView (part 1)
sections.title: Clear-data confirmation and file import
sections.what: Defines the clear workspace action, which asks for confirmation before wiping data. Also reads a chosen JSON file and sends its text to the store, showing an alert if the import fails.
sections.why: Likely reason: the confirmation and alert guard against accidental wipes and bad files.
sections.watch_out: The confirmation prompt is the only protection before everything is erased, and import does not preview the data before replacing it.

sections.name: SettingsView (part 2)
sections.title: Persona choices and module toggles
sections.what: Shows three persona buttons, each with a description and an ACTIVE tag on the chosen one. Defines five life-area modules, and for each one a toggle that adds or removes it from the enabled list and saves the profile.
sections.why: Likely reason: personas change the wording shown across the app, and modules control which areas appear in navigation.
sections.watch_out: If the profile has no enabled list, the first toggle starts from the full default list, so one click may not do what the user expects.

sections.name: SettingsView (part 3)
sections.title: Module checkboxes, theme and audio
sections.what: Draws each module row with its label and checkbox. Shows the colour mode switch, and an audio feedback checkbox that turns sound on or off straight away.
sections.why: Likely reason: each setting is a simple on or off switch, so checkboxes are used.
sections.watch_out: Changes take effect at once, with no save button.

sections.name: SettingsView (part 4)
sections.title: Notifications and data backup buttons
sections.what: Shows the notifications checkbox, then the data buttons: export JSON, export CSV, import JSON backup, and clear all data. A hidden file picker sits behind the import button.
sections.why: Likely reason: the hidden file picker is a common way to make a styled button open a file dialog.
sections.watch_out: Data lives in the browser, so clearing site data or switching browsers loses it unless a backup was exported.

summary: The settings page: choose a persona, switch life-area modules on or off, set theme and sound, and back up, restore or clear data.
purpose: Controls how the app looks and behaves, and how the user's data is backed up.
why: Likely reason: keeps all personal preferences and data tools in one place.
how: Reads the profile and settings from the store. Persona buttons and module checkboxes write new values. The sound and notification checkboxes save straight away. Export buttons create JSON or CSV files. Import reads a chosen JSON file and passes its text to the store. Clear asks for confirmation, then wipes the data.
inputs: Clicks, a JSON file chosen by the user, and the stored profile and settings.
outputs: Updated preferences in the store, downloaded backup files, restored data, or cleared data.
risks: Clear All Workspace Data erases everything, and its only guard is one confirmation prompt. Importing replaces data without a preview. Toggling a module writes the profile twice in a row.
debug: If settings do not stick, check the store's update functions and the browser's saved data. If an import fails, the page shows an alert, so check that the file is a JSON export from this app. If modules reset, check the enabled modules field on the profile.
